scope: Controlled verified TLS peer; actual Linux loopback capture; Surf Chrome profile; no native browser capture or NIC pacing claim
loopback_accounting: Linux loopback ingress/egress filter accounting reports each packet twice; the pcap records one copy. Protocol assertions use the recorded packet streams.
method: One RST_STREAM HTTP_1_1_REQUIRED, HTTP/1 fallback, pooled repeat, CloseIdleConnections, TCP Preconnect and another HTTP/1 request. Raw pcap and key logs remain private.
